title.narrative: EU4Business – The EU Local Currency Partnership Initiative: The European Fund for Southeast Europe (EFSE)

description.narrative: The EU contribution of EUR 43 700 000 under this Agreement will be used to subscribe the newly issued European Eastern Neighbourhood L shares that will act as dedicated share class to support local currency lending. The EU contribution of EUR 5 000 000 under this Agreement will be used to subscribe to European Eastern Neighbourhood C Shares that jointly with other investors will enable the financing of EFSE projects in the Eastern Partnership countries.
